d:
Yes, I used AI because my hands shake, but my mind is perverted. So I was able to take what is in my brain and make it real for you and the ungrateful asslords who sit around whining about AI.

It's here, get over it. who gives a fuck.

These stories sort of evolved over time, each one is stand alone. I used a lot of different art styles, and a metric fuck ton of paint.net which is like 1.8 to a regular American fuck ton.

If you are still reading this, may I ask why? Please read the comics.

On a side note, I have no idea how to tag galleries, so i anyone would be so kind as to explain in comments, I'd appreciate it.
n: [Western] Dumb Mommy - Original Four Panel Comics [AI Generated]
